fileNodes.name: claude.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Wraps the Claude Agent SDK query() into a long-lived, message-at-a-time Claude worker session whose run(text) resolves with the final reply; also builds a subscription-only environment that strips stray Anthropic API overrides.

fileNodes.name: compare.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Side-by-side model comparison node: sends one question to up to four sources (local Claude, local Codex, or any OpenRouter model) in parallel and emits their answers with timing and cost.

fileNodes.name: git.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Git plumbing for worker workspaces: initializes the workspace repo, creates per-task worktrees on their own branches, reports diffs, merges accepted branches, and removes worktrees, all committed under a local Trident identity.

fileNodes.name: library-tools.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Builds an in-process MCP server exposing list/read/write tools over the shared Markdown Library to Claude-harness agents, where writes become unsaved drafts the user approves.

fileNodes.name: talk-tools.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Builds an in-process MCP server with say/read team-talk tools for Claude-harness workers, plus a digest helper that surfaces unread board messages without ever waking other agents.

fileNodes.name: team.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Core worker-team orchestrator: assigns Lead tasks to Claude, Codex, or OpenRouter workers in isolated git worktrees, gates risky edits, broadcasts file-edit notes and clash warnings, runs cross-vendor review rounds, and merges or rejects results.

fileNodes.name: workplaces.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Manages multiple isolated workplaces (each with its own folder, board, Lead, team and compare node) persisted in data/workplaces.json, handling create, remove/archive, goal cancellation and folder validation.

fileNodes.name: codex.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Codex worker adapter that keeps one long-lived codex app-server process running and talks to it over JSON-RPC on stdio, giving the rest of Trident per-thread conversations, approval forwarding and out-of-usage tracking.

fileNodes.name: library.mjs
fileNodes.summary: The shared Markdown Library: a plain folder of notes in sections that every agent can read, where every change is first stored as a draft and only becomes the real note when the user saves it, with replaced versions kept under .old.

fileNodes.name: openrouter.mjs
fileNodes.summary: OpenRouter integration that reads the API key and model from the process or Windows user environment and builds the environment that points the Claude Agent SDK worker at OpenRouter's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, plus a no-cost key and model check.

fileNodes.name: server.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Trident's entry point: a local HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 that wires together the gate, Codex, OpenRouter, Library, settings and workplaces, streams every event to the page over server-sent events, and handles the POST routes for workplaces, messages, approvals, plans, interrupts, Library actions and settings.

fileNodes.name: settings.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Trident-wide settings store kept in data/settings.json, currently holding the maximum number of workers per workplace, with validation and a settings event on every change.

fileNodes.name: board-tools.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Defines the in-process MCP server of board tools the Lead agent calls (propose_plan, update_task, finish_goal, assign_task, accept_task, reject_task, ask_several, team_say), so the Lead changes the board and team only through validated tool calls.

fileNodes.name: board.mjs
fileNodes.summary: SQLite-backed board store (via node:sqlite) holding goals, their tasks and team talk; handles schema creation and column migrations, plan proposal, task updates, and renders the [state] block fed to the Lead.

fileNodes.name: gate.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Approval gate that holds an agent's risky tool calls until the user allows or denies them, persisting 'always allow' and 'always deny' rules per exact operation to a JSON file.

fileNodes.name: lead.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Runs the Lead agent as one long-lived Claude Agent SDK session fed by an async message queue, wiring in board and library MCP tools and the approval gate, and streaming its output as UI events; also exports a one-line tool-call summarizer.

fileNodes.name: requests
fileNodes.summary: Tiny runtime counter file used by the autoharness Claude Code plugin to queue skill-learning requests; it holds a single character and no project logic.

fileNodes.name: launch.json
fileNodes.summary: Claude Code launch configuration that starts the Trident engine with `node src/server.mjs` and points the preview at http://127.0.0.1:4317.

fileNodes.name: config.json
fileNodes.summary: Understand-Anything tool settings that fix the knowledge-graph output language to English.

fileNodes.name: README.md
fileNodes.summary: Project overview explaining Trident's Lead/worker/cross-check model, workplaces, Ask several, Library and approvals, plus requirements (Node 26, git, Claude/Codex logins), setup, optional OpenRouter keys, folder layout, work flow diagram, status and privacy notes.

fileNodes.name: agent-collab-teardown.md
fileNodes.summary: Research teardown comparing how Band, Coral and PandaOS coordinate AI agents (chat-room @mentions, task board with proof of completion, Director router) and the ideas Trident borrows from each.

fileNodes.name: design.md
fileNodes.summary: Design document for Trident: the problem, the Lead-plan-approve-worker-cross-check-merge flow, the engine pieces (SDK adapters, team tools, SQLite board, worktrees, approval gate, state snapshot), the interface sketch, milestones M1-M4 and open questions.

fileNodes.name: package.json
fileNodes.summary: npm manifest for the private ES-module Trident package; `npm start` runs src/server.mjs and the only dependencies are the Claude Agent SDK and the Codex SDK.

fileNodes.name: ember.css
fileNodes.summary: Ember design-system stylesheet for the web page: dark warm oklch color tokens, radius and glass/shadow variables, and ds-* component styles for buttons, inputs, cards, badges, alerts, switches, tabs, steppers, sliders, tables and chips, with touch, small-screen and hover media rules.

fileNodes.name: index.html
fileNodes.summary: Single-page Trident interface: sidebar of workplaces plus Library and Settings views, a Lead chat, a Needs-you approvals bar, the goal/task board, team talk, activity log and Ask-several comparison columns, all driven by an inline script that consumes the server's /events stream and posts actions back.

fileNodes.name: appserver.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Spike that drives `codex app-server` over stdio JSON-RPC with a long-lived thread, timing startup and two turns and declining any server approval requests.

fileNodes.name: claude.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Spike confirming the Claude Agent SDK runs on the existing Claude Code login, sending one isolated prompt with settings, plugins and MCP servers disabled.

fileNodes.name: codex.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Spike confirming the Codex SDK runs on the existing Codex login by streaming one read-only turn and printing events and usage.

fileNodes.name: e2e-team.mjs
fileNodes.summary: End-to-end script against the running server: sends a request, auto-approves the plan and every approval, and logs board, message, talk, tool and status events from the /events stream until the goal is done.

fileNodes.name: or-check.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Free check of the configured OpenRouter key and model: runs the config's validity check and prints account tier and usage from the key-info endpoint without generating text.

fileNodes.name: or-models.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Lists tool-capable coding models from the public OpenRouter catalog with prices, and reports whether given model ids are still listed.

fileNodes.name: or-route.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Checks the OpenRouter route with a deliberately invalid placeholder key, expecting both the key check and a Claude-session worker turn to be refused, at no cost.

fileNodes.name: twoturn.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Spike measuring whether SDK slowness is a one-time startup cost or per-message, using one streaming Claude session with two messages or two Codex runs on one thread.
